source_chain.fact: OnRemoteRequest checks interface descriptor, captures calling pid/uid for logging, finds the transaction code, and invokes the mapped member. The descriptor comparison is interface identity validation; no permission/token authorization call is visible in this method.
OnGetPasteData calls GetPasteData(pasteData); on success it serializes the value with reply.WriteParcelable. No in-method permission check is visible.

GetPasteData selects the caller's OS user via GetUserId and returns that user's clip. GetUserId maps IPCSkeleton calling UID to a local OS account; this is user scoping, not an explicit permission decision.
The interface declares GetPasteData without a permission annotation; the proxy writes the interface token and sends GET_PASTE_DATA. The client wrapper delegates to the proxy.

The component contains PasteboardPermission::CheckCallingPermission, but repository-wide permission-reference search found no call from the GET_PASTE_DATA stub, service GetPasteData implementation, proxy, or service registration path.

PasteboardService inherits external SystemAbility and PasteboardServiceStub classes and calls Publish during Init. The full SystemAbility/IPC skeleton enforcement implementation and product-side policy are outside this repository snapshot.
